description: The files of a head session's lineage that its rotation hook reads, and the environment and hook payload it takes. The Node handoff store (src/session-rotation/handoff-store.mjs) writes latest.json and the handoff files, the rotation executor (src/session-rotation/rotate.mjs) writes rotation.json and answered.json, and the Rust reader is packages/session-host/rust/src/rotation/handoff.rs. Folder: <the project directory the head was started in (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, else the cwd)>/.fgos/runtime/session-rotation/<persona>-<name>/ (persona and name are lowercase slugs).

latest.json.writer: handoff store, replaced atomically after the handoff file exists

shape.file: string, <yymmdd>-<hhmm>-<sid8>.md, the newest handoff file of the folder

latest.json.readerRule: a pointer that is missing, not one JSON object, or names a file that is not a handoff file name or is gone means no handoff

handoff file.carries: a line `Rotation id: <16 lowercase hex characters>` when a rotation executor wrote it; a `## Pending question (verbatim)` section on a hard rotation
handoff file.sessionStart: the reader inlines the text when it is under 10000 characters, else a pointer to the file plus the pending question verbatim

context-sidecar.jsonl.writer: a status-line wrapper, optional; none ships with fgOS

shape.ts: number of epoch milliseconds, or an ISO-8601 string (YYYY-MM-DD[THH:MM[:SS[.fff]]][Z|+HH:MM], UTC without an offset)

context-sidecar.jsonl.readerRule: only a record newer than the Stop hook's own timestamp is fresh; the hook waits up to 1500 ms for a record (the file may appear during the wait), then the transcript (one turn stale) is used

environment.FGOS_HEAD_ROLE: set by the head start door; its presence is the only gate, the hook never parses it
environment.FGOS_HEAD_PERSONA: the persona slug, declared in the session envelope's env by the head start door
environment.FGOS_HEAD_NAME: the head's name slug, declared the same way
environment.FGOS_HEAD_GEN: the generation of this head's lineage
environment.FGOS_HEAD_REQUEST_SOCKET: the head request socket (head-request.v1.json); without it the hook asks nothing

hook.never: blocks, prints to the conversation (only session-start prints, one hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext object), or exits other than 0
hook.stop: a successor whose generation the pending rotation waits for answers with `head answered` (the rotation id from its handoff); every other stop measures, decides and on soft or hard asks `head rotate`; a stop that answered does not also measure
hook.pendingQuestion: no lineage state defines a pending owner question yet, so the hook never reports one: soft is never held by a question, and a hard rotation carries the last assistant message verbatim
